title: Amortized Thompson Sampling and Efficient Information-Directed Sampling for Simulator-Based Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.32514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Thompson sampling is a widely used strategy for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, offering a principled way to balance exploration and exploitation. This strategy involves maximizing a target objective under a single sample drawn from the current belief over unknown quantities. Conventionally, this optimization is performed once the belief has been inferred from data, and it becomes computationally burdensome when many Thompson samples are required, especially in continuous action spaces. In this work, we introduce an approach that amortizes this process ahead of time, before any data is collected, so that an approximation of the full Thompson sampling distribution is available immediately once observations arrive. We employ this approach to solve the multi-round setting, involving sequential data acquisition and Thompson-sample recommendation across rounds. translated_title: 摊销式汤姆逊采样与面向基于模拟器设计的高效信息导向采样
translated_abstract: 汤姆逊采样是一种广泛应用于不确定性环境下序贯决策的策略，它提供了一种在探索与利用之间进行权衡的原则性方法。该策略需要在从当前关于未知量的信念中抽取的单一样本下最大化目标函数。传统上，这一优化是在从数据中推断出信念之后才进行的，当需要大量汤姆逊样本时，计算负担会变得十分沉重，尤其是在连续动作空间中。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种方法，可以在收集任何数据之前提前摊销这一过程，使得一旦观测数据到来，即可立即获得完整汤姆逊采样分布的近似。我们运用该方法求解多轮设定，即在多轮之间进行序贯数据采集与汤姆逊样本推荐。除了加速汤姆逊采样之外，我们的方法还实现了高效的信息导向采样。
tldr: 该论文提出一种摊销式汤姆逊采样方法，在数据收集前预先计算汤姆逊采样分布的近似，使观测到来时能够立即获取样本，从而大幅加速多轮序贯决策，并实现高效的信息导向采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an amortized Thompson sampling approach that pre-computes an approximation of the full Thompson sampling distribution before data collection, enabling immediate sample availability upon observation and efficient multi-round sequential decision-making and information-directed sampling for simulator-based design.
